usecase.name: User Login
usecase.scenario: A registered user sign in into his Tripadvisor account.
steps: User attempts to post a review or manage a booking.
System prompts the user to log in.
User enters their email and password.
System verifies the credentials and logs the user in.
User continues with the initial action (e.g., review submission or booking).

testcases.name: Valid Login via Action
testcases.description: Verify that a user is logged in when performing an action that prompts for login (e.g., submitting a review).
steps: User attempts to submit a review.
The user selects a third-party login method (e.g., Google or Facebook).
System successfully logs the user in.

expected.outcome: User is logged in and can continue the action.

testcases.name: Invalid Login via Action
testcases.description: Verify that the system handles invalid login attempts via a third-party login provider.
steps: User attempts to submit a review.
User selects a third-party login provider but fails authentication.

expected.outcome: Login fails and user is notified.

usecase.name: Trip Planning
usecase.scenario: A user creates a trip plan by adding places to visit, hotels, and restaurants.
usecase.preconditions: User is logged in and has started a trip plan.

testcases.name: Valid Trip Plan Creation
testcases.description: Verify that a user can successfully create a trip plan with valid details.

testcases.name: Trip Plan with Missing Details
testcases.description: Verify that the system handles trip planning with missing places or hotels.

expected.errorMessage: At least one place must be added.
